title: CropTracker
tagline: CropTracker is a dashboard for gardeners, yield farmers, and agriculturalists
description:
Yield Farming Dashboard that keeps track of:

-Initial seed investments 
-Planting fees (initial transaction)
-Current value of my crops
-Current yield of my crops
-Estimated harvest fees (removal transaction)
-Estimated break even given sampled yields
-The total profit/loss of each crop given all of the above^
how_its_made:
I built a React app that lets you enter an Ethereum address and it will generate a dashboard view that lets you view your current yield farms.



Tech I used:

-NextJS

-TypeScript

-TailwindCSS



Zapper API - I use this to fetch protocol balances to display the initial crops, as well as pull historical transaction data to populate seed info. 

Yearn API - I use this to determine the APY of farms.  This is still a WIP

Coingecko API - I use this to determine the historical value of seed transactions.  This is still a WIP.
